bullets.text: sorting a drawer of cables. three of them go nowhere. keeping all three.
duck at okunoin in light rain. today's line: send with third-eye, receive with heart. the cedars took it as weather.
rain finds the one gap in the roof tiles and uses it every time. never bothers looking for a second.
steady. the flat kind, not the good kind, but it holds.
the umbrella does not stop the rain. it changes whose problem it is.
